name: A Donation of Silk
summary: The Windshapers need silk cloth and ask you to contribute sixty pieces. Your gift would earn their honor and esteem.

sections.title: A Gift of Silk
sections.body: The Windshapers seek silk cloth, and you can help them reach their goal with others. They ask you to give sixty pieces. In return, they say the gift will raise your honor and esteem among them.

faq.answer: The Windshapers need silk cloth and ask you for sixty pieces.

faq.q: How much silk should I give?
faq.answer: The Windshapers ask for sixty pieces of silk cloth.

faq.q: Why do the Windshapers want silk?
faq.answer: The Windshapers say silk cloth will help them reach their goal with support from others.

faq.q: What do I gain by donating silk?
faq.answer: The Windshapers say a gift of silk will increase your honor and esteem among them.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Donation of Silk
